sources.notice: CC0 1.0 Universal. Thanks to Quaternius (quaternius.com) for the free monster packs.
sources.note: The License.txt inside the downloaded folder is headed "Ultimate Platformer Pack"; the CC0 status is taken from the brief and the pack owner. Check it before shipping.

held.reason: Dropped at the look check (sheet batch-1): the packed MDL renders as a tiny, dark silhouette in three.js. The geometry bounds are correct (0.9 m) and the winding is not the cause (double-sided renders the same). Open: the MDL morph-target path (scripts/pack-monsters.mjs packMdl). The Quake clip ranges above are kept for when it is fixed.
Dropped with hound-lq (the same MDL render fault). Its clip ranges are estimated and unverified.
